planning_notes: No serial interfaces were specified in the requirements or resolved configuration; therefore serial_channels is empty.
Control-period chosen as 5 ms as a safe scheduling granularity since no explicit real-time deadline was given beyond the 1-second buzzer behavior (handled in model using elapsed_ms).
Button inputs D2 and D3 are modeled as Boolean with default polarity (catalog default). Both are assumed unpressed => false at startup.
Buzzer output is modeled as a single tone channel; the model is responsible for asserting a tone for exactly 1000 ms when the displayed count reaches 60, then continuing counting.
TM1637 seconds display starts at 0; the model is responsible for incrementing through at least 60 seconds and updating the displayed value accordingly.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个学习计时器系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于开始/暂停计时，D3 用于清零；数码管显示秒数，到达 60 秒时蜂鸣器鸣叫 1 秒，并继续计时。
